title: Four Christmases
tagline: Four houses. Four dinners. One very full couple.
about: A couple stuck in town on Christmas Day has to visit all four of their divorced parents.
cue: Serve the snacks when the fog cancels every flight out of San Francisco.
faces: "We told everyone we were off to Fiji. Now we're eating four Christmas dinners in one day, so pace yourself."
Cranberry and orange juice with honey rosemary syrup and frozen cranberries.

Mini beef pies with puff pastry tops and tomato sauce.
Brad's rough dad and brothers who wrestle in the yard.

    StartersRosemary spiced nuts and pretzelsAlmonds, cashews and pretzels baked with rosemary, brown sugar and flaky saltHow to make it150g almonds150g cashews100g pretzels1 tbsp chopped rosemary2 tbsp brown sugar2 tbsp olive oilflaky salt, to tasteToss the almonds, cashews and pretzels with the oil, rosemary, brown sugar and salt on a lined tray.Bake at 180°C, stirring once, until golden and fragrant. Cool on the tray, then bag them up.Jumping castle party piesMini beef pies with puff pastry tops and tomato sauceHow to make it500g beef mince1 brown onion, finely diced250ml beef stock2 sheets of shortcrust pastry2 sheets of puff pastry1 tbsp olive oil1 tbsp plain flourtomato sauce, to serveCook the onion in the oil, add the mince and brown it well. Stir in the flour, then the stock, and simmer until thick. Cool completely.Cut rounds from the shortcrust to line a patty tin and rounds from the puff for the lids. Fill the cases, top with the lids and press the edges to seal.Bake at 200°C until puffed and golden. Squirt tomato sauce on top to serve.Howard's slow-braised bratwurst bitesBrad's rough dad and brothers who wrestle in the yardHow to make itAs written, serves 4Bratwurst simmered in root beer with onions, then grilled until charred, sliced into bites and served on toothpicks with hot mustard and the sticky root beer onions.Slice 3 onions and put in a wide pan with 8 bratwurst, 375ml root beer and 20g butter.Simmer gently for 15 minutes.Lift out the sausages and grill over high heat until charred all over.Keep boiling the onions until the liquid is gone and they turn sticky and golden.Slice the bratwurst into thick bites, spear with toothpicks and serve with the onions and hot mustard.MainsNativity play Christmas hamBrown sugar and Dijon glazed ham with potato salad and green beansHow to make it3kg leg ham150g brown sugar2 tbsp Dijon mustard2 oranges, juiced1kg potatoes, cut into chunks300g green beans, trimmed150g mayonnaiseScore the ham skin and rind. Mix the brown sugar, Dijon and orange juice into a glaze and brush it over.Bake at 180°C, basting often, until the glaze is sticky and deep golden.Meanwhile boil the potatoes until tender, adding the beans for the last few minutes. Drain, cool and toss with the mayonnaise.Rest the ham for 10 minutes, then carve and serve with the potato salad.Church supper beef lasagneThe nativity play at the church with Brad as JosephHow to make itAs written, serves 4Beef ragù simmered slowly with tomato and grape juice, layered with lasagne sheets, béchamel and mozzarella, baked bubbling and rested before slicing.Brown 800g beef mince with an onion, carrot and 3 garlic cloves.Add 150ml grape juice, 2 cans crushed tomatoes and oregano and simmer 2 hours.Melt 50g butter, stir in 50g flour, whisk in 600ml milk and simmer until thick, adding nutmeg and 50g parmesan.Layer ragù, 300g lasagne sheets and béchamel in a dish, finishing with béchamel and 200g mozzarella.Bake at 180°C for 45 minutes and rest 20.SweetsFamily games night trifleOrange soaked sponge, raspberry jelly, custard, cream and fresh raspberriesHow to make it1 sponge cake, cut into chunks60ml orange juice1 packet raspberry jelly crystals500ml custard300ml thickened cream, whipped125g raspberriesPut the sponge chunks in a trifle bowl and drizzle with the orange juice.Make up the jelly following the packet, pour it over the sponge and chill until set.Spoon over the custard, then the whipped cream. Chill overnight so it settles.Top with the raspberries just before serving.DrinksCranberry, orange and rosemary punchCranberry and orange juice with honey rosemary syrup and frozen cranberriesHow to make it3 tbsp honey100ml water4 rosemary sprigs, plus extra to float750ml cranberry juice500ml fresh orange juice100g frozen cranberries2 oranges, sliced1 L cold ginger ale1 bag iceSimmer the honey, water and 2 rosemary sprigs for 3 minutes, then cool and remove the rosemary.Mix the cranberry juice, orange juice and syrup in a big bowl. Add plenty of ice, the frozen cranberries and sliced oranges.Top with the ginger ale just before serving and float a few rosemary sprigs on top.
